displayName: Allow media autoplay on specific sites
description: Define a list of sites, based on URL patterns, that are allowed to autoplay media. If you don't configure this policy, the global default value from the "AutoplayAllowed" policy (if set) or the user's personal configuration is used for all sites. For detailed information about valid url patterns, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2095322. Note: * is not an accepted value for this policy.
